candidates.title: Course document upload, move and delete lifecycle
candidates.preconditions: Course 'CL-DOC-101' exists; clean document directory; synthetic file 'syllabus.pdf'.
candidates.gherkinScenario:
Feature: Course Document Management
  Scenario: Course document upload, move and delete lifecycle
    Given teacher "prof_smith" is logged into Claroline course "CL-DOC-101"
    When the teacher navigates to Documents and uploads file "syllabus.pdf"
    Then "syllabus.pdf" appears in the course root document directory
    When the teacher moves "syllabus.pdf" into folder "LectureNotes"
    Then "syllabus.pdf" is displayed inside "LectureNotes" directory
    When the teacher deletes "syllabus.pdf"
    Then "syllabus.pdf" is removed from "LectureNotes" and no longer visible
candidates.fixture: Setup: Create course and folder. Teardown: Remove document and clean directory.

oracle.observable: Document records in claro_document table update path during move and delete marks record deleted; filesystem confirms file existence then removal.

novelty.rationale: Proposal targeting unexercised behavior beyond baseline. Baseline overlap analysis: Baseline exercises exercises, user enrollment, and calendar events, but zero document lifecycle tests.

baselineOverlap.rationale: Baseline exercises exercises, user enrollment, and calendar events, but zero document lifecycle tests.
baselineOverlap.comparisonBasis: Reconciled with 257 features, 258 test suites, 359 assertions in bewt-original/

candidates.negativeControl: An enrolled student without edit rights cannot see Move or Delete action buttons.

candidates.title: Group space is inaccessible to a non-member student in a private group
candidates.role: Teacher configures private group; student is non-member
candidates.preconditions: Course has closed private Group B; Student 1 is enrolled in course but NOT in Group B.
candidates.gherkinScenario:
Feature: Group Space Authorization
  Scenario: Group space is inaccessible to a non-member student in a private group
    Given course "CL-GRP-101" has private group "Private Group B" with closed registration
    And student "student_bob" is enrolled in course "CL-GRP-101" but is not a member of "Private Group B"
    When student "student_bob" attempts to access the URL for "Private Group B" space
    Then the student is redirected to the main groups list with notification "Not allowed"
    And the private group document repository and group forum are NOT rendered
    And no self-registration option is displayed for the private group
